# Work Experience & Enterprise History (LLMS.txt)

## Current Role
- **Krom Bank Indonesia** (June 2026 – Present)

  - **Technologies**: Google BigQuery, dbt, Elementary, Airflow Composer, Python, Mode BI.
  - **Key Impact**: Established cross-platform data quality checks conforming to DAMA data quality dimensions and automated upstream issue tracing.
